@@ -1,7 +1,14 @@
 """Parse version strings like "1.2.3" or "1.2.3-beta.2"."""
 
 
+
 def parse(version: str) -> dict:
-    major_s, minor_s, patch_s = version.split(".")
-    return {"major": int(major_s), "minor": int(minor_s),
-            "patch": int(patch_s), "pre": ""}
+    parts = version.split("-")
+    base_parts = parts[0].split(".")
+    pre_parts = parts[1].split(".") if len(parts) > 1 else []
+    return {
+        "major": int(base_parts[0]),
+        "minor": int(base_parts[1]),
+        "patch": int(base_parts[2]),
+        "pre": ".".join(pre_parts),
+    }
